purpose: Canonical remote knowledge, native brush assets, process evidence, V2 anti-undercoverage rules, and delivery templates for $brush-creator-studio
resolver_policy: Read this manifest before resolving reusable brush/process data.
Current user artwork is the highest-priority project evidence.
Resolve exact repository paths from registries; do not guess binary asset paths.
Perform Full Production Stage Decomposition and Object/Material Map before Brush Role clustering.
Optimize for Minimal Complete Production Set, not minimum brush count.
A normal complete illustration with fewer than 8 final roles triggers UNDERCOVERAGE_REVIEW_REQUIRED unless full coverage is defensibly demonstrated.
Run Brush Specialization Gate and Merge Eligibility Gate before any merge.
Filename and purpose_hint are discovery hints only, never validated behavior.
Relevant unvalidated candidates remain PENDING_VALIDATION and may not become NEW only because validation is unavailable.
Mode B PACKAGE PASS requires actual final .brush files, one complete .brushset, and the project XLSX.
Do not rename arbitrary files to fake .brush/.brushset/.abr.
Git LFS pointers are not native .brushset inspection.
Only claim FULL PASS after real target-software import/drawing validation or equivalent validated native workflow.
